item.title: Fatherhood Diaries: nutrition and eating dead animals
item.description: It was the first year of my undergraduate degree, the afternoon after the last exam, when I joined a friend at the pier at Southampton for a few beers and a steak. That was the last time I ate meat, more than a decade ago. What started as a challenge – to stay without meat for a week – became an unlikely lifestyle, given that meat was the main stable in my diet up to that day.
